lane: data-store-design (design only: no data moves, no tool edits, no existing file changes)

base.clone: E:/ChimeraWork/datastore-agent (blob:none sparse: tools, docs, Chimera, ChimeraEngine, core, story)

theory.statement: RAW acquired datasets (and bulk extracted model geometry) can live OUTSIDE git in a plain sha256-addressed content store at E:/ChimeraData/store/, with a committed index manifest and a resolution layer honoring CHIMERA_DATA_STORE (in-repo path as default fallback), and the funnel's proofs lose nothing.
theory.prediction_1: Pilot (wiseman2026): registering its already-gitignored raw+extracted corpus (273 files, 94,643,527 B, all sha256-pinned by wiseman2026/sha256_manifest.json) into the store, resolving through the new layer, leaves every gate exactly as green as at 6ea2702c: creature_graph suite 69 OK, science_funnel suite OK, matter_kernel test_definition 9/9, training_gate PASS.
theory.prediction_2: pin_crosscheck --own <post-pilot> --target <post-pilot> reports zero new collision/stale verdicts versus its 6ea2702c baseline; every wiseman receipt pin verifies against store-resolved bytes.
theory.prediction_3: wiseman_osim.py served by the resolution layer verifies all 7 wrapped models byte-for-byte (sha256_manifest.json) and emits receipts whose data_root/sha pins match the pre-pilot form.
theory.prediction_4: Phase-3 clone win (measured expectation, NOT assumed): after morphosource + remaining RAW phases, a fresh sparse clone's tools/science_funnel/data checkout drops from 369,762,399 B to <= 70,000,000 B and its pack contribution drops from the measured 259.1 MB by >= 240 MB, because data blobs are the worst-compressing mass in the pack (zips/tifs: 352.6 MB logical -> 259.1 MB packed, 73% ratio, vs docs/evidence 8,712 MB -> 95.4 MB).
theory.prediction_5: byte-stability is preserved at every step: store-resolved bytes == committed blob bytes (content addressing makes drift structurally impossible while a path remains in-repo; after removal, the index manifest + download receipts re-fetch and re-pin)

falsifier.pilot: If ANY gate that is green at 6ea2702c (creature_graph 69 OK / science_funnel suite OK / matter_kernel test_definition 9/9 / training_gate PASS) turns red on the pilot worktree, OR pin_crosscheck reports any collision or stale pin that its 6ea2702c baseline does not already report, OR wiseman_osim.py refuses with source_pin_drift under store resolution, THE DESIGN IS WRONG: stop, report, no further phases.
falsifier.phase3: If after the morphosource and remaining-RAW phases the measured fresh-clone data checkout is smaller by less than 300,000,000 B, or any receipt in tools/science_funnel/validation/ fails its sha pin re-verification against store bytes, THE CLAIMED WIN IS WRONG: the store stays for future acquisitions only and the migrated blobs return to git (append-only history untouched).
falsifier.metric_recording: each migration step records: bytes in git before/after (ls-tree + cat-file --batch-check with objectsize and objectsize:disk), gate verdicts verbatim, pin_crosscheck verdict table

honest_limits: blobs already in git HISTORY stay there: no history rewrite, the append-only law holds; the win is per-checkout duplication and future acquisitions, not repo size
the wiseman pilot moves ZERO bytes out of git (its raw corpus is already gitignored); the pilot proves the machinery, phase 2/3 move the mass
fresh-clone checkout size and pack size are different numbers and both are reported (checkout: full-tree bytes; pack: delta-compressed disk bytes)
